label: prf:confinement-categorical
title: Proof of confinement categorical
html:
Proof.

(1) is spectral sequence collapse: \mathrm{HH}^k(A) = 0 for k \geq 1 (Whitehead's lemma for semisimple algebras), so E_\infty^{p, q} = 0 for p + q \geq 1. Only E_\infty^{0, 0} = \mathrm{HH}^0 = Z(A) remains.

(2) Cyclicity of the Markov trace (\int_A ab = \int_A ba) means \int_A vanishes on commutators [A, A]. Since A / [A, A] \cong Z(A) at the \mathrm{HH}^0-level, \int_A descends to Z(A). The induced map \mu : Z(A) \to R sends e_\lambda \mapsto \int_A e_\lambda = w_\lambda.

(3) Wedderburn decomposition A = \bigoplus_\lambda A_\lambda with A_\lambda = e_\lambda A e_\lambda gives \int_A a = \sum_\lambda \int_{A_\lambda} a for any a \in A. Apply with a = \rho(\beta_\mathcal{K}) \cdot \mathcal{T}. \square

Confinement reading.

Each clause is the categorical reflection of a confinement statement in QCD:

Clause Algebra QCD analogue
(1) Non-central elements die at E_\infty Free quarks not observed
(2) \int_A factors through Z(A) All observables are gauge-invariant
(3) Observables = sum of Wedderburn residues Hadrons = sum of color-singlet projections

The curvature 2-cocycle F encoding the Hecke + Yang–Baxter relations (curvature-rank stratification) plays the role of the string tension categorically: F is the obstruction to extracting a non-central element through the GB filtration, just as the QCD string tension is the obstruction to extracting an isolated quark.

Curvature-rank as confinement layer.

The strata J^k / J^{k+1} index "confinement layers": deeper k = more commutator load = harder to extract. At k = 0 (the centre) elements are completely free; at k \geq 1 extraction requires energy proportional to F. The chirality channel D_q^2 = 0 (q-Dirac cell scanner witness) supplies the persistent gauge-invariant background analogous to the gluon condensate, with \mathrm{Vol}(B_3) = 8 G matching \dim \mathfrak{su}(3) = 8.

Predictive consequence.

The hadron mass formula (unified mass formula) \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}} = \sum_k \alpha_k \cdot \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(1) is — read through this proposition — literally a sum over confinement layers. Term k of the formula is the contribution of the curvature-rank-k confinement stratum. The rank-3 chirality residue (\mathrm{Vol}(6_1) \cdot |(q;q)_3|) and the rank-\geq 4 universal Pochhammer tail in the structural \mathfrak{Q}_\beta derivation (Q-beta path A extended witness) are confinement residues, not independent ingredients.
